@June, Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with support on 1 Jul in #strategic-pod. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team, so no custom CSV export was needed.

One caveat: a 30 Sep strategic digest also names #8841, but for a different problem (Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk). I can't tell from the channel whether that's a reused number or a related case, so it's worth checking the ticket itself.
